title: 第十章 秘境预备班的名单第九章 导师的特殊点名
lines: 第十章：秘境预备班的名单
清晨的薄雾还未散尽，幻境学院的钟楼刚敲过七下，中央广场上已挤满了人。
青石铺就的广场边缘，那面高约三丈的“公告水晶墙”正散发着柔和的淡蓝色光晕。水晶墙是学院的标志性魔法造物之一，由十位高阶水晶法师耗费三年心血熔铸而成，能同时承载上百条信息的显影，且自带扩音与记忆魔法——任何被刻印在上面的内容，不仅能清晰地呈现在所有人眼前，还会在二十四小时内自动留存备份，供错过的人回溯查看。
此刻，水晶墙前的人群像被无形的力场按了暂停键，鸦雀无声。
昨天下午，院长艾德里安在全院大会上宣布了一则重磅消息：为应对近期校园内频发的能量异动，学院将重启停办近百年的“秘境预备班”。这个班级不按年级划分，不限国籍，只招收二十名“在魔法天赋、心性韧性或特殊感知力上有突出表现”的学生，由学院七位资深导师亲自授课，目标是“培养能应对未知魔法危机的储备力量”。
消息一出，整个学院都沸腾了。
“秘境预备班……我奶奶说过，这班级在百年前可是传说级别的存在！”一个扎着双马尾的灵都国女生拽着同伴的袖子，声音发颤，“据说能进这个班的，最后要么成了各国魔法议会的长老，要么成了守护秘境的关键人物！”
“关键是‘秘境’两个字吧？”旁边一个穿着魔法国制式皮甲的男生摸着下巴，眼神发亮，“学院一直讳莫如深的那些‘特殊区域’，会不会就是所谓的秘境？”
“别瞎猜了，快看！水晶墙亮了！”
人群中有人低呼一声，所有人的目光瞬间聚焦到那面水晶墙上。原本淡蓝的光晕骤然转为鎏金色，如同有液体在水晶内部缓缓流动，随后，一行行古朴的魔法文字凭空浮现，悬浮在墙面中央。
最上方是班级名称——【幻境学院·第一届现代秘境预备班】，下面则是按姓氏首字母排序的名单，每个名字后面都标注着所属国籍、年级和一项“入选特质”。
人群的呼吸声仿佛都被这鎏金文字吸走了，只能听到水晶墙表面魔法能量流动的细微嗡鸣。
“安雅·晨星，镜幻国，三年级，特质：镜像拟态。”
“第一个是镜幻国的安雅！她不是去年就在镜像魔法大赛上拿了金奖吗？果然有她！”
“贝利·霍克，魔法国，二年级，特质：大地共鸣。”
“哦！是那个能让岩石听话的家伙！我上次看他在试炼场把整块花岗岩捏成了盾牌！”
名字一个个浮现，议论声也跟着此起彼伏。被念到名字的学生或激动得攥紧拳头，或强装镇定地挺直脊背，没被念到的则在紧张地搜寻着自己的名字，眼神里满是期待与忐忑。
林澈站在人群偏后的位置，踮着脚尖才能勉强看到水晶墙的上半部分。他穿着一身洗得有些发白的学员制服，袖口还沾着昨天在元素教室练习空间折叠术时不小心蹭到的银灰色粉末——那是空间魔法失控时产生的“虚空尘”。
他的心跳得有点快。
作为一个来自幻灵国边境小镇的平民，能考入幻境学院已经是全村的骄傲。他不像那些贵族子弟从小接受系统的魔法教育，唯一拿得出手的，就是那连自己都没完全弄明白的“空间感知”——能模糊地“看到”物体周围的空间褶皱，甚至在极度专注时，能预判出小型魔法的轨迹。
昨天导师办公室里，负责新生考核的艾琳导师曾单独找过他。那位总是戴着单片眼镜的女导师指尖夹着他的考核报告，镜片后的目光锐利如鹰：“林澈，你的空间感知力很特殊，虽然目前还不稳定，但潜力远超同龄学员。秘境预备班需要你这样的人才，做好准备。”
当时他以为是客套话，没敢当真。毕竟，他的元素魔法成绩只能算中等，体能测试更是刚过及格线，怎么看都不像能进“精英预备班”的样子。
“凯·炎纹，魔法国，一年级，特质：火焰亲和（高阶）。”
鎏金文字跳到这一行时，人群中爆发出一阵明显的惊叹。
“炎纹家族的人！难怪……”
“听说他入学第一天就把试炼场的火元素柱给点燃了，连火系主任都惊动了！”
林澈顺着声音看去，只见人群前排，一个红发少年正双手抱胸站在那里，脸上没什么表情，但微微扬起的下巴还是泄露了他的得意。那就是凯，魔法国炎纹家族的直系后裔，以一手霸道的烈焰魔法在新生中闻名，也是林澈在元素课上的同桌——虽然两人几乎没说过话。
凯似乎感觉到了他的目光，侧过头扫了他一眼，眼神里带着点不易察觉的审视，随即又转了回去，继续盯着水晶墙。
林澈收回目光，心里那点期待又淡了几分。连凯这样的天才都入选了，自己恐怕真的只是被艾琳导师安慰了一下而已。
“苏璃·绿藤，灵都国，一年级，特质：植物通感。”
新的名字出现，人群的惊叹声更柔和了些。
“是灵都国的苏璃！她上次在植物园帮濒死的千年古藤复苏了，据说连皇室的植物法师都想收她当弟子！”
“她人超好的，上次我被失控的荆棘藤缠住，还是她帮忙解围的……”
林澈顺着众人的视线看向不远处。一个穿着浅绿色长裙的少女正站在那里，亚麻色的长发编成麻花辫垂在肩头，脸上带着一丝惊讶，随即被温和的笑意取代。她身边围了几个女生，正兴奋地跟她说话，她时不时点头回应，举止优雅又亲和。
那是苏璃，灵都国贵族出身，却丝毫没有架子。林澈记得，在开学典礼后的魔法交流会上，他因为空间感知失控差点撞翻一个水晶展柜，是苏璃及时用藤蔓拦住了他，还轻声安慰他“别紧张，魔法本就需要慢慢磨合”。
名单还在继续滚动，已经出现了十五个名字，各个都是学院里小有名气的人物。林澈的心跳渐渐平稳下来，心里那点侥幸也消失了——果然没有自己。
他正准备悄悄退出人群，去图书馆补昨天没看完的《空间魔法基础理论》，身后突然有人轻轻撞了他一下。
“喂，还没念完呢，急着走？”
一个清冷的女声在身后响起。林澈回头，看到一个穿着镜幻国传统银色长袍的女生。她的头发是罕见的淡紫色，皮肤白得近乎透明，最引人注目的是她的眼睛——瞳孔像是被打磨过的黑曜石，看人的时候总带着一种穿透感，仿佛能直接看到对方的心底。
是月姬，镜幻国来的转学生。关于她的传闻不多，只知道她的镜像魔法异常出色，甚至能在镜子里留下带有自主意识的残影。林澈和她没说过话，只在几次选修课上见过她独自坐在角落，对着窗玻璃发呆。
“没……没什么，”林澈有些不自然地移开目光，“我就是觉得……应该没我的名字。”
月姬没说话，只是抬眼看向水晶墙。她的视线落在名单的第十六位上，眉头几不可察地皱了一下。
“第十六位，雷克斯·铁盾，幻灵国，三年级，特质：防御结界强化。”
“第十七位，莉莉娅·风语，灵都国，二年级，特质：风之语者。”

Chapter 10: List of Secret Realm Preparatory Classes
The morning mist has not yet cleared, the bell tower of Fantasy Academy has just struck seven times, and the central square is already crowded with people.
At the edge of the square paved with bluestone, the "Announcement Crystal Wall" about three feet high is emitting a soft light blue halo. The crystal wall is one of the academy's iconic magical creations. It was made by ten high-level crystal mages who spent three years of hard work. It can carry the visualization of hundreds of messages at the same time, and has its own amplification and memory magic - any content engraved on it can not only be clearly displayed in front of everyone, but will also be automatically saved within 24 hours for retrospection by those who missed it.
At this moment, the crowd in front of the crystal wall seemed to have been pressed by the pause button by an invisible force field, and they were silent.
Yesterday afternoon, Dean Adrian announced a big news at the college-wide meeting: In response to the recent frequent energy changes on campus, the college will restart the "Secret Realm Preparatory Class" that has been closed for nearly a century. This class is not divided by grade or nationality. It only recruits twenty students with "outstanding performance in magic talent, mental toughness or special perception". They are personally taught by seven senior instructors from the college. The goal is to "cultivate reserve forces that can cope with unknown magic crises."
As soon as the news came out, the entire college was in a state of excitement.
"Secret Realm Preparatory Class... My grandma said that this class was a legendary existence a hundred years ago!" A girl from Lingdu Country with twin ponytails tugged on her companion's sleeves, her voice trembling, "It is said that those who can enter this class will eventually either become the elders of the magic councils of various countries, or become key figures guarding the secret realm!"
"The key is the word 'secret', right?" A boy wearing the Magic Kingdom's standard leather armor next to him touched his chin, his eyes shining. "Could those 'special areas' that the academy has always kept secret be the so-called secrets?"
"Stop guessing, look! The crystal wall lights up!"
Someone in the crowd shouted, and everyone's eyes instantly focused on the crystal wall. The originally light blue halo suddenly turned into gilded gold, as if liquid was slowly flowing inside the crystal. Then, lines of ancient magic words appeared out of thin air, suspended in the center of the wall.
At the top is the class name - [Illusion Academy·The First Modern Secret Realm Preparatory Class], and below is a list sorted by the first letter of the last name. After each name is marked the nationality, grade and a "selected characteristic".
The breath of the crowd seemed to be sucked away by the gilded words, and only the subtle hum of the magic energy flowing on the surface of the crystal wall could be heard.
"Anya Morningstar, Mirror Fantasy Country, third grade, trait: Mirror Mimicry."
"The first one is Anya from the Mirror Fantasy Kingdom! Didn't she win the gold medal in the Mirror Magic Competition last year? She is indeed there!"
"Bailey Hawke, Magic Kingdom, second grade, trait: Earth Resonance."
"Oh! It's the guy who can make rocks obey! Last time I saw him shape a whole block of granite into a shield at the trial field!"
Names emerged one by one, and discussions followed. The students whose names were read clenched their fists in excitement, or straightened their backs while pretending to be calm, while those whose names were not read were nervously searching for their names, their eyes full of anticipation and anxiety.
Lin Che stood at the back of the crowd, standing on tiptoes to barely see the upper part of the crystal wall. He was wearing a student uniform that had been washed a little white, and his sleeves were still stained with the silver-gray powder that he accidentally rubbed while practicing the Space Folding Technique in the Elements Classroom yesterday - it was the "void dust" produced when space magic went out of control.
His heart was beating a little fast.
As a commoner from a small border town in the Phantom Kingdom, being admitted to the Phantom Academy is already the pride of the whole village. Unlike those aristocratic children who received systematic magic education since childhood, the only thing he could do well was the "spatial perception" that even he didn't fully understand - he could vaguely "see" the spatial folds around objects, and even predict the trajectory of small magic when he was extremely focused.
Yesterday in the tutor's office, tutor Eileen, who was in charge of freshmen assessment, came to see him alone. The female instructor who always wore a monocle held his assessment report between her fingertips, and her eyes behind the lenses were as sharp as an eagle: "Lin Che, your spatial perception is very special. Although it is not stable yet, your potential is far beyond that of students of the same age. The Secret Realm Preparatory Class needs talents like you, so be prepared."
At that time, he thought it was a polite comment and did not dare to take it seriously. After all, his elemental magic scores were only average, and his physical fitness test just passed the passing mark. He didn't look like he could enter the "elite preparatory class."
"Kai Flame Pattern, Magic Kingdom, first grade, trait: flame affinity (high level)."
When the gilt text jumped to this line, there was a clear exclamation from the crowd.
"People from the Yanwen family! No wonder..."
"I heard that he lit the fire element pillar in the trial field on his first day of school. Even the director of the fire department was alarmed!"
Lin Che followed the sound and saw a red-haired boy in the front row of the crowd standing there with his hands folded on his chest. His face had no expression, but his slightly raised chin still betrayed his pride. That was Kai, a direct descendant of the Flame Pattern family in the Magic Kingdom. He was famous among the freshmen for his domineering flame magic. He was also Lin Che's classmate in the element class - although the two had barely spoken.
Kai seemed to feel his gaze, and turned his head to glance at him, with an imperceptible scrutiny in his eyes. Then he turned back and continued to stare at the crystal wall.
Lin Che withdrew her gaze, and the expectation in her heart faded a bit. Even a genius like Kai was selected. I was afraid that I was just comforted by instructor Erin.
"Su Li Green Vine, Lingdu Country, first grade, trait: plant synesthesia."
The crowd's exclamations softened as new names appeared.
"It's Su Li from Lingdu Kingdom! Last time she helped revive the dying thousand-year-old vine in the botanical garden. It is said that even the plant mage of the royal family wants to accept her as a disciple!"
"She is a very nice person. The last time I was entangled by out-of-control thorn vines, she helped to rescue me..."
Lin Che followed everyone's gaze and looked not far away. A girl wearing a light green dress was standing there, with long flaxen hair braided and hanging on her shoulders. There was a trace of surprise on her face, which was soon replaced by a gentle smile. There were several girls around her, talking to her excitedly. She nodded in response from time to time, her manners were elegant and friendly.
That was Su Li, who was born into a noble family of Lingdu Kingdom, but had no airs at all. Lin Che remembered that at the magic exchange meeting after the opening ceremony, he almost knocked over a crystal display cabinet because he lost control of his spatial perception. Su Li stopped him in time with a vine and comforted him softly, "Don't be nervous, magic needs to be adjusted slowly."
The list continues to scroll, and fifteen names have appeared, all of which are well-known figures in the academy. Lin Che's heartbeat gradually calmed down, and the bit of luck in her heart disappeared - as expected, she was no longer there.
He was about to quietly withdraw from the crowd and go to the library to study "Basic Theory of Space Magic" that he had not finished yesterday, when someone suddenly bumped into him slightly from behind.
"Hey, you haven't finished reading yet. Are you in a hurry to leave?"
A cold female voice sounded from behind. Lin Che turned around and saw a girl wearing the traditional silver robe of Jinghuan Kingdom. Her hair is a rare lavender color, and her skin is almost transparent. The most eye-catching thing is her eyes - the pupils are like polished obsidian. When she looks at people, there is always a sense of penetration, as if she can directly see the bottom of the other person's heart.
It's Yue Ji, a transfer student from Jing Huan Country. There are not many rumors about her, except that her mirror magic is extremely good, and she can even leave an afterimage of her own consciousness in the mirror. Lin Che had never spoken to her, and had only seen her sitting alone in a corner in a few elective classes, staring blankly at the window.
"No...it's nothing," Lin Che looked away unnaturally, "I just think...it shouldn't have my name."
Yue Ji didn't speak, she just raised her eyes and looked at the crystal wall. Her eyes fell on the sixteenth number on the list, and she frowned almost imperceptibly.
"Sixteenth, Rex Iron Shield, Phantom Kingdom, third grade, trait: strengthened defensive barrier."
"The seventeenth, Lilia Wind Whisperer, Lingdu Kingdom, second grade, trait: Wind Whisperer."
